- For auditor sampling, we provide transfer logs with per-object SHA256 and a joined manifest with timestamps. That manifest is the primary artifact auditors will sample.

Cost/contract note: The temporary capacity uplift will be billed as a one-time usage charge and may require a minimal term amendment for Dedicated customers who need guaranteed capacity during that period. Ben will open a short note with finance if you confirm.

- Confirm if Nov 9 is acceptable start date for the 72-hour uplift, or if you prefer a different window.
